contacts_reachable_check.name: contacts_reachable_check
contacts_reachable_check.value: "contacts"."email" is not null or "contacts"."phone" is not null

credit_notes_parties_check.name: credit_notes_parties_check
credit_notes_parties_check.value:
"credit_notes"."seller_name" is not null and "credit_notes"."seller_line1" is not null and "credit_notes"."seller_country" is not null
          and "credit_notes"."bill_to_name" is not null and "credit_notes"."bill_to_line1" is not null and "credit_notes"."bill_to_country" is not null

invoices_draft_shape_check.name: invoices_draft_shape_check
invoices_draft_shape_check.value:
"invoices"."status" <> 'draft' or (
            "invoices"."number" is null and "invoices"."issued_at" is null and "invoices"."issued_by" is null
            and "invoices"."subtotal" is null and "invoices"."tax_total" is null and "invoices"."total" is null
          )

invoices_issued_shape_check.name: invoices_issued_shape_check
invoices_issued_shape_check.value:
"invoices"."status" = 'draft' or (
            "invoices"."number" is not null and "invoices"."invoice_date" is not null
            and "invoices"."issued_at" is not null and "invoices"."issued_by" is not null
            and "invoices"."subtotal" is not null and "invoices"."tax_total" is not null and "invoices"."total" is not null
            and "invoices"."seller_name" is not null and "invoices"."seller_line1" is not null and "invoices"."seller_country" is not null
            and "invoices"."bill_to_name" is not null and "invoices"."bill_to_line1" is not null and "invoices"."bill_to_country" is not null
          )

invoices_void_shape_check.name: invoices_void_shape_check
invoices_void_shape_check.value:
("invoices"."status" = 'voided') = ("invoices"."voided_at" is not null)
          and ("invoices"."voided_at" is null) = ("invoices"."voided_by" is null)
          and ("invoices"."voided_at" is null) = ("invoices"."void_reason" is null)

invoices_due_after_issue_check.name: invoices_due_after_issue_check
invoices_due_after_issue_check.value: "invoices"."due_date" is null or "invoices"."invoice_date" is null or "invoices"."due_date" >= "invoices"."invoice_date"

invoices_countries_format_check.name: invoices_countries_format_check
invoices_countries_format_check.value:
("invoices"."seller_country" is null or "invoices"."seller_country" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')
          and ("invoices"."bill_to_country" is null or "invoices"."bill_to_country" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')
          and ("invoices"."ship_to_country" is null or "invoices"."ship_to_country" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')

locations_org_parent_code_key.name: locations_org_parent_code_key
locations_org_parent_code_key.where: "locations"."code" is not null and "locations"."parent_id" is not null

locations_org_root_code_key.name: locations_org_root_code_key
locations_org_root_code_key.where: "locations"."code" is not null and "locations"."parent_id" is null

orders_ship_to_snapshot_check.name: orders_ship_to_snapshot_check
orders_ship_to_snapshot_check.value:
("orders"."ship_to_line1" is null and "orders"."ship_to_country" is null)
          or ("orders"."ship_to_line1" is not null and "orders"."ship_to_country" is not null)

product_licences_dates_ordered_check.name: product_licences_dates_ordered_check
product_licences_dates_ordered_check.value: "product_licences"."issued_at" is null or "product_licences"."expires_at" is null or "product_licences"."issued_at" <= "product_licences"."expires_at"

shipments_void_complete_check.name: shipments_void_complete_check
shipments_void_complete_check.value: ("shipments"."voided_at" is null) = ("shipments"."voided_by" is null) and ("shipments"."voided_at" is null) = ("shipments"."void_reason" is null)

stock_movements_has_location_check.name: stock_movements_has_location_check
stock_movements_has_location_check.value: "stock_movements"."from_location_id" is not null or "stock_movements"."to_location_id" is not null

stock_movements_distinct_locations_check.name: stock_movements_distinct_locations_check
stock_movements_distinct_locations_check.value: "stock_movements"."from_location_id" is null or "stock_movements"."to_location_id" is null or "stock_movements"."from_location_id" <> "stock_movements"."to_location_id"

stock_movements_adjustment_note_check.name: stock_movements_adjustment_note_check
stock_movements_adjustment_note_check.value: "stock_movements"."reason" <> 'adjustment' or ("stock_movements"."note" is not null and length(btrim("stock_movements"."note")) > 0)
